title: Company lead
description: One company (no contact yet) written to leads/companies/*.json by apify-ingest from company-discovery and signal sources (Google Maps, job postings, events). The crawler (Apollo) or apify-ingest's LinkedIn company-employees source later finds people at these companies and stamps people_searched_date.

website.description: Domain or URL; empty if unknown

employee_count_hint.description: Rough headcount if the source gives one; 0 = unknown

signal.description: local_employer | hiring_people_function | hr_event_organizer | new_office | growth | other

signal_date.description: Date the signal was observed/posted, YYYY-MM-DD when known

posting_title.description: job_postings sources: the role title that triggered the signal

people_searched_date.description: Set once a people source has searched this company; absent = still to do

source_id.description: Stable id from the source (placeId, posting id, event id)
